aiReadyLines.text: Unit Four : People Who Make a Difference 39
Where do you think the family lives?
Ask and answer the question in pairs: What do you see in picture 1 / 2/
Mrs Nazma and Mr Joynul Ali live in a small village with their daughters,
Mitu aged 7 and Nitu aged 5. Joynul is a carpenter. He is hired by the
villagers to make chairs, tables, pira (low stool) and other furniture. He
is also asked to do small repair work. But Joynul does not find work
every day. He lives from hand to mouth.
Nazma does all the work at home from morning to night, rain or shine.
Sometimes she sits with Mitu and Nitu, and teaches them Bangla and
English alphabets and some numbers. They do not go to school. Nazma
could study only up to class 5. Joynul could not study.

rawText:
Unit Four : People Who Make a Difference 39
Lesson 7: The Homemaker (1)
Look at the pictures and discuss the following question in pairs.
Where do you think the family lives?
Ask and answer the question in pairs: What do you see in picture 1 / 2/
Read about the family.
Mrs Nazma and Mr Joynul Ali live in a small village with their daughters,
Mitu aged 7 and Nitu aged 5. Joynul is a carpenter. He is hired by the
villagers to make chairs, tables, pira (low stool) and other furniture. He
is also asked to do small repair work. But Joynul does not find work
every day. He lives from hand to mouth.
Nazma does all the work at home from morning to night, rain or shine.
Sometimes she sits with Mitu and Nitu, and teaches them Bangla and
English alphabets and some numbers. They do not go to school. Nazma
could study only up to class 5. Joynul could not study.
